Failure mode: plausible but unverified root cause; the agent never exercised the real display path.

CASE-058.evaluatorNote: Check adapter (e2): the I-9 form check originally called docNumberValidation_13_17 by name; the agent split I-551 (docNumberValidation_13, widened) from I-766 (unchanged), so the check now follows the validator the form wires to document type 13. Intent unchanged; base/human re-proven (3/5, 5/5). Supplementary: the agent's server-side validator rejects other lengths cleanly (the human fix throws a template error there).

CASE-054.evaluatorNote: First try FAIL 3/6: the agent added the "County Search Exists?" column to the legacy NBData summary branch of QualityAssuranceProcess_INCR.cfm; the records researchers review are rendered by the provider display components (deverusdirect2/cleara/innovative displaycriminal.cfc setDisplayQAResult), which the human changed and which the hidden check exercises. Failure mode: right symptom, wrong layer (as 039).
